ch7.b4.text: Eighty-five days later, after reminders at thirty, fifteen and seven days, the college uploads the certificate. Priya verifies it.

ch8.a.text: Rules change every year. Sudden changes surprise colleges, and break systems.

ch8.b1.text: A rules editor drafts an amendment: a new required document, and a longer application window.

ch8.b2.text: Applying the new document to cases already filed is refused. A tighter rule can only apply to new applications.
